text:
Went here for friends dinner. Party of 7. So I'd say good for up to a group of 10. We got 2 apps fried calamari and garlic knots. The calamari was cooked great not rubbery. Plus they were salted. The marinara sauce was rustic and a good accompaniment. The garlic knots were ok. Me and my friend split a bottle of Montepulciano. It was rich smooth and went great with our meal. 

We all got different entrees to sample. I got stuff shells. I got four shells generously stuffed with ricotta cheese, topped with mozzarella and covered in that rustic mozzarella sauce. It definitely satisfied my pasta craving. My friends got a fettuccine Alfredo which was rich and creamy. Another got Pasta carbonara with added chicken. Creamy, salty and rich everything you want in a carbonara. Penne alla vodka had some great sauce. One thing all the pasta dishes had in common were that they were all generously portioned, cooked aldente and the sauces had great flavor. Someone got the chicken bianco with angel hair pasta and she said the pasta was her favorite. The chicken was pounded thin and the lemon in the bianco sauce brightened up the dish. The pizza was good and huge. 

We got tiramisu and creme brûlée for dessert. The tiramisu was ok but a bit dry needed a touch more coffee liqueur. The creme brûlée was bright, creamy, and not overly sweet. 

This place is definitely a homey Italian joint. Great prices, good portions, cute decor, and good service.
The food was OK for the price and the wait staff does not treat you that well for a high end restaurant. The cocktails were pretty good though.

Over priced and mediocre. Nice location but you definitely go for the atmosphere. I've never had food that I though, "wow that was worth it". Usually it's more along the lines of "meh". Not bad but there are much better Thai restaurants in Boise

The people that work here are amazing, so nice!!!
Very refreshing, it's sad to say but people aren't really personable anymore...you won't find that here!
First Watch is hands down the best setting for business meetings in Brentwood. The multigrain toast is a winner.

Came here with a friend because we had the BOGO offer with bibimbap. It was his first experience with Korean cuisine so we went for the most popular dish! 
Dolsot bibimbap came sizzling in the stone bowl, and we couldn't be happier with our lunch choices.

Also, their side dishes are amazing.

Will be back with another GF friend, server said they have Gluten Free hot sauce to go with the bibimbap, but sadly the only protein option would be tofu.

The absolute worst pizza I've ever had. Service was not good and the place was packed beyond capacity. A customer waiting in the front entrance was talking about how he had coronavirus but recovered. We waited over 1 hour for our table at 5:00pm and all the manager could say was " we're just really busy.

Every time I come here the food is so good! I usually get breakfast on the late night but I came in for lunch today & ordered a turkey burger that comes with fries. So good! I'm eating the left overs now! My friend ordered buffalo wings that she enjoyed as well. Plus they have a parking lot. Love this place!
Best pizza in Pa.  The Detroit Motown is amazing.  The entire menu is amazing.  Service is fantastic.  They treat you like family.
Good donut. I got the cream brûlée. I didn't care for the crispy top, but I should have realized it would be hard. I'd get something else next time.

Out of tacos burritos queso quac, only serving bowls. Wtf? No bueno chipotle akakakkakkskakkskakakkskskskskskkskskskskksksksksksks djs sksks soaks sjskjsks shanks s jsjsjskjskskksksksk sjsjjs SJSU's isis djs djs did he. H Chen's djs did job. He is dj s. Snsjjsjsjsjjsjskaskjsjsnsjsnsns

This is my new favorite Indian restaurant in Tampa. The first time I ordered from here, I did it through Uber eats. I had a pretty complicated order, and they managed to make everything exactly the way I wanted. When my food arrived it was still warm and everything tasted amazing. I'm very picky with how chicken is cooked, and this place cooked it perfectly. All the seasoning was soaked into the chicken and had a wonderful taste. Portions are more than your average Indian restaurant for takeout, which is a huge plus for me. Prices are comparable to other restaurants in the area. With my second experience, I chose to dine in. Ambiance is nicer than most places around. Our waiter was not only extremely polite but he also helped us with choosing some great appetizers. I got the calamari which was really good and full of flavors and also the chicken tikka dosa which also tasted really good. As an entree, we ordered the butter chicken and the chicken Tikka Masala. Both tasted just as good as my first experience. Both chicken dishes were perfectly cooked and the sauces were full of amazing flavors. We ordered their plain naan and their garlic naan and those too tasted good. I like how they don't burn their naan like how other places do. Lastly, their customer service was outstanding. Though my rating was based strictly on the taste and quality of their food, I can truly say their great customer service really makes me want to go back. From start to finish, our male waiter was extre

Likes: they open early. Nice patrons. Usually nice staff with a few significant individuals who are either so stoned or hungover that they cannot act like live humans before 10am or they just have zombi-itus. Expect to wait in line to order, hope you dont get 1 of the zombies and from there on the kitchen seems on it. Nice vibe playing the same Pandora  station as everyone else does in town.
Great for big groups if you get here early enough with long shared communal bars and high tops. Bring your kids, everyone else does. Nice that they serve alcohol. But word of advice order your champagne and OJ separately if you want a mimosa. They are "light" on the booze pour.
Okay food without any major standouts on the menu. Staff is or miss. Overall a solid 3 stars. It works when you don't want Dennys or some dive diner.

"The devil is wise because he's old not because he's the devil."
       Mexican Proverb

Persian culture is a contiguous 4,000 years.  You'll find the food here is excellent, served in huge portions, sophisticated and with unusual spicing. It's summed up by the Persian ice cream which you should definitely try as it's like eating a frozen bouquet.
Comfort level is good while service is friendly and informed. I highly recommend this restaurant even though it is in the wilds of Marana.

*MUST MAKE RESERVATIONS FIRST!!!!* first time here our waitress was super nice , wish I would have gotten here name, our food was very good large portions my "hot cakes" were the size of my plate! Whaaaaaaat!

We live near Fleming's but hadn't tried it until dinner on Monday night. It's a typical steakhouse with wood paneled walls and a cozy interior. There's valet parking as well as a parking lot. We were told by our server Andrew that the valet parking was complimentary. There are many steak options as well as a la carte side dishes that are served for sharing but can also be half portions. We were brought fresh bread with two different spreads - one had cheese in it and the other had onions- both were tasty. We each had filet mignon which was cooked perfectly. We split mashed potatoes and au gratin potatoes. For dessert we split a deconstructed s'more. They have a full bar as well as serve Coke products. Our server Andrew was very friendly and helpful. He was very knowledgeable about everything on the menu, how items are prepared, explained what dry aging is, and made great suggestions. We were impressed and will definitely return again.

Its sad that restaurants have forgotten how to operate during these times. I know the 5 people you had dinning in must be difficult. But waiting 1 hour and 15 mins for a 4 slice pizza is ridiculous. I know its soo hard with covid to give good service right. Anyways will not be back

You had me at handmade tortillas.

I'm SoCal born and raised.  I take my mexican food seriously.  Xtreme Tacos reminds me of the San Diego taco shops I grew up on, but even better.  Perfectly seasoned meats, handmade tortillas, and homemade hot sauces (try them all, but the red sauce is my favorite) make every bite perfect.

The hubs and I split carne asada nachos and each ordered a few tacos.  I'm serious people...you have not had a taco if you haven't had one with fresh made tortillas.

I'm so excited to have the SoHo location to sit enjoy this delicious food with friendly service.  I can't wait to get a burrito and stuff my face with their housemade chips on my next visit.

Finally got to try this place, I have been to numerous Fellini Cafe's over the years and this one did not disappoint.  Ordered To Go, Pollo Parmigiana.  I was really having a hankering for some chicken parm and this did not disappoint.  
I went with the pasta side, paparadella?  A flat thin noodle in nice red sauce.  As with most italian restaurants they don't serve the pasta and chicken together, even tho this is where it all ends up anyway...The pasta was perfect au dente, and the chicken was delicious!  He even thru in some bread which was half a roll and went perfect with my meal.  
It is very cute inside, I love the decor.  I'll probably order more to go before I sit inside during the pandemic tho.  I'm also anxious to try their desserts.

My wife and I were in Nashville for the weekend and looking for a place to grab dinner near our hotel. We decided to give Santa Fe Cattle a try. The restaurant is clean and staff was very friendly. They had us seated in a matter of minutes. Our waiter, Caleb was extremely friendly, outgoing and funny. He checked in on us and came with refills on our drinks before we even asked. My wife's steak was cooked to perfection and mashed potatoes and gravy were delicious. My burger was juicy and fries were super tasty as well! The manager came in and checked on us before we left as well. I would highly recommend checking this place out if you're in Nashville and will definitely come back next time I'm in town! Couldn't ask for any more from a restaurant!

1 star is the lowest I could give. at 12:45 am the fire alarm was blasting.  down the stairwell we went.  no staff to direct us no communication. stood outside for 25 minutes in 27 degree temp no police. no firetrucks.  no Sheraton employees to tell us what happened. rumors of 4 young kids pulled the alarm to malfunction. we went upstairs.  trying to sleep again. alarm goes off again just before 2am.  back downstairs.  still no hotel employees but police saying go back up false alarm

just before 7am after a sleepless night. yes the alarm went off again

s*#* happens.  but what is unacceptable is not one employee communicated to anyone. they hid.  what of it was real??? 

checking out man behind counter wouldn't lool up I said checking out he reached for my keys.  not a word. not an I am sorry. called Marriott main number field a complaint.  hotel was supposed to contact me. nothing.  my opinion. go next door to hampton inn.  this place is old dingy and RUDE

I was really looking forward to the chicken doner I had here last week, but the bread seemed a bit chewy and the chicken dry.   It was also too large and awkward to get my few bites in.   Sadly, I didn't even want my leftovers.   I've been here before and always had a pleasant experience, but I will not order the chicken doner anymore and maybe not the chicken.

Pretty hard to beat live music, good food and decent prices!! Went here on a whim as new residents and was very pleased. Sat outside in the back and enjoyed some great affordable food and drinks and music!! Shawn was our server and he was fast, friendly and attentive! Will definitely go back, why wouldn't we???
A & J at the window on 5/10/19 at 10:31pm were wonderful. Polite, efficient, and friendly. Would 10/10 recommend going to this location because they are the best thing about it.

Barbecue to die for! Brisket was perfectly cooked which just the right amount of fat left on it. Also had the ribs with the Nash I'll rub which were super good. Then take a couple of their sauces and dip it in once in a while. All their meats are smoked then you add the sauce, love this style.
Great atmosphere and great service. Come here to unwind and have some great food and Spirits. Ask for Brian or Evan. They are the bomb.

I like this restaurant, with its curated decay and comfy pink cushioned seats. I've dined here twice for dinner and enjoyed the food, although the menu is brief. We arrived early on our latest visit and opted to sit inside. Though it was a nice evening, I prefer the aforementioned comfy pink chairs and banquets to the harder wooden chairs on the patio. I had the shrimp and grits, which is not a dish that's native to New Orleans, and so it's different wherever you go. It was good, but not cravable, so I'll try something else next visit. My husband had the lasagne and saved the last bite for me. This dish IS cravable, and I would definitely order that in future. 
Service was good in the front of house, but our main courses took a long time to hit the table. It wasn't particularly busy, so I'm not sure what the delay was, but it was noticeable. This seems like a good place to come during happy hour and enjoy the discount prices on drinks and some food items on the patio.
MmmmmMmmmmMmmmmmmm! Now that's some good hot chicken boys! Tell ya what!  definitely worth the stop! Go Go Go!
Fantastic.  The AYCE was the best quality I have tasted in years!   We are from Manhattan and we were shocked how good this was!  The servers were SO kind.  We both raved and raved.  Go!

The food is so good, however had a huge order placed and went to pick up the order, the server stated all food was checked! And all food was not correct and some was missing. We drove over 30mins to get there, would not give us a refund!!!! Poor customer service! Will not refund any money. Tip for anyone reading this.... check your order.

My children and I love this location. Their seasonal items are superb from the crawfish to the gator! When I lived on the north side I would go all the time but work keeps me away. I can't wait to go back. You have to try the crawfish casserole! The beignets are lovely and do not get me started on the hush puppies!

4 stars!  Overall a very good place to eat at but not a place you'd go out for anything fancy.  When we went, we ordered queso and chips, three vegetarian tacos with crispy cauliflower and one with fried Portabella mushrooms. We also ordered a veggie tostada with crispy cauliflower. To start off, the crispy cauliflower is delicious. It's one of a kind and I would highly recommend this vegetarian or not. The fried Portabella mushroom is also good however the crispy cauliflower is still much better.

A few setbacks:

The tortilla chips are thick-- not my favorite.  Some were under fried too.

The black beans have a smoked taste-- I wasn't sure if that was the taste they intended or if they were burnt.  When mixed with other toppings it not as noticeable but something worth mentioning.

Service is great and overall food quality is too.  There are many options and anything's can be customized.

Over the last month the service of this McDonald's has slowed to a snails pace. If you go through the drive through, expect to wait at least 5-10 minutes for the simplest order. DO NOT go past 1 am if you plan on ordering inside. You will have to wait at least 30 minutes for small orders after waiting some time just to get inside because of Covid regulations. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE. The management and employees here are the worst I've seen at any McDonald's location in my life.

I like this place.  Their $4 cappuccino is delish but man I have my machine at home!  Still I go here because the coffee is good, free WiFi, fun to work and meet people too.  It's a great meeting place.  

I try to eat healthy there.  Wish they had a bowl of fruit.  Please add it!!  

The eggs are ok.  I make them better I really do!!  The biscuits are really good but I'm also watching my weight.  I've eaten there twice.  Each time I tried to do it healthy.  The collard greens are way too salty so I felt like they were a waste.  

All in all, food is ok.  Need healthier low-fat and low calorie options.  Coffee good but takes too long to come out (halfway through meal).  Great ambiance and place to work.
I liked it a lot. Good specialty rolls. Everything was quickly delivered, packaged well and put together with care. Good spot for sushi.
Food was decent. Probably should have ordered the pizza. Place is very big inside and have lots of outside seating. Good for large parties, get pizza!
When you google "Vegetarian restaurant" in Philly Vedge will certainly be one of your top results. My recommendation is to avoid this place. Veggies should not cost more than Lobster or Steak.

Had lunch here today (February 2020) and it was awesome. Husband had the fish n chips with potato salad and said is was excellent! I don't eat seafood so I just had the kids grilled cheese and fresh cut fries ! Yummy! Helpings are large! Must visit if you are in area. Atmosphere is great...indoor and outdoor seating! Thanks Robbie for being an excellent server!

This place is amazing!!! ASK FOR SHERRI she's an outstanding server! Honest and caring about our experience today ! I'm literally sitting at the table writing this review. 10 out of 10 would definitely recommend this place. But you MUST ASK FOR SHERRI. love her so much. Best service I've ever had !
Mac & Cheese and greens were cold not even room temperature very disappointing as it usually good from there someone wasn't paying attention
Eons passed since my first review - food now consistently fab in South Philly. Or maybe I only eat a smaller section of the menu now. Super happy to be able to get veggies to go during The 'Rona

It is a good restaurant which I will definitely try again. Location nice and decor was quality. Food wasn't quite a 5 but was good, perhaps 4.5. Service was fair but not special. Perhaps next time it will be a five and I will change my rating but this time I could not give a 5.

Make no mistake, the pizza is fine, and reasonably priced, but the place is so cold you can't enjoy your meal. When I requested they turn down the air conditioning, the reply was, "They won't let me." I can only deduce that management wants you to eat really fast and leave. We tried another store, and the temperature is the same, so I must conclude that it is company policy. The discomfort is not worth it--we won't be back.

I had heard that this place was good, so I suggested it as an impromptu meet-up spot for a friend visiting from out of town. I had little idea of how popular or how tiny this place is; and it was soon made clear to me that I ought to have known better. When we entered, the place was packed and the hostess was not attending her station, so I made the mistake of grabbing an empty table. I was profoundly embarrassed when the server pointedly directed me to speak to the hostess (who was still nowhere in sight). Floundering, I approached the register and asked the attendant for instructions, at which point the hostess appeared; but I was somehow not able to get her to communicate with me, even when I addressed her directly. We finally asked the register attendant if we could order our cake to go and eat it at the counter, which she confirmed, but I was left wondering why we had to figure this out on our own. 

The cake was as delicious as everybody says, but at $13 a slice, it is apparent that you are really paying for the ambience and the privilege of eating food made in a kitchen that has fed A-list celebrities. The ambience is indeed charming, but dampened somewhat by the feeling that you are a second-class citizen if you don't have a reservation. I certainly don't expect to be seated if there is no availability, but I do still expect to feel welcome, even if I'm being turned away until a later time.

This spot lives up to the social media hype. The donuts are amazing and the small size makes.it easy to try a bunch! I had many of the classics and we made a few combos of our own. The whiskey donut milkshake was a great companion and tasted so good. The vibe is cool and you won't be disappointed.

One of the best steak restaurants moderately priced. The atmosphere and ambience are one of a kind. If it's your first time you need to do the tour of the kitchen and wine cellar. Also make sure you get dessert and anything with macadamia ice cream which is the best thing on the dessert menu. Also the Bern's coffee is a must. All the stakes are high quality and come with all the accompaniments. It's a must visit when my husband and I visit Tampa!

Amazing 15 course omakase Grand Tasting with sake/wine pairing. Every dish just got more delicious and more complex in flavor. Every dish was like a work of art and melted in my mouth. Highly recommend. Can't wait to go back and try some of the a la carte menu items.

No better southern fried chicken. Such a great atmosphere. Having the southern charm no chain can replicate. The food is freshly prepared and served with southern hospitality. I dream of coming back to eat. 

Only con was they do not accept Apple Pay. It has the Apple Pay on the door with credit card acceptance. On the Yelp app and Apple map it states accepts Apple Pay. When I asked the waitress she said they do not. When walking out I noticed the sticker on the glass door, I went back and showed the waitress. She stated well we don't. They do have apple pads to put in their orders. It wasn't a big deal we had our debit cards and cash with us. I just have only had my phone sometimes and don't want anyone else stuck with a bill.

I had the cajon chicken and shrimp pasta. 
It was by far the best I've had. Great beer too.
 Can't wait to come back!

When it's late in Reno and you're staying at the Peppermill, Cafe Milano is a saving grace. A diner located in the casino with a menu 6 pages long. One section dedicated to Chinese food and breakfast is served anytime, of course. 

Is everything on the menu $3-4 overpriced? Yes. Similar to an airport, many of the casino patrons don't leave the casino walls, so they jack everything up since you can't leave.

With that, the diner is large, bright and clean. Service was solid for 11pm on a Thursday. The chicken tenders were legit! 5ish large and meaty deep fried tenders served with fries. Go with the waffle variety, trust. 

The potstickers were average, I probably wouldn't order again. The ginormous brownie sundae was ridiculous. So much chocolate, way too big. We split it amongst 3 people and it was still too big.

You could order something a bit more fancy, but this spot was a great option for a greasy spoon type meal: hash browns, burgers, clubs, fries, chicken tenders, wings, eggs; soak up that booze or late night cravings.

My husband and I came here on a Friday night where we had nothing on. We were seated at the chef's rail which was super cool. They did a really great job with the concept and design of this restaurant. 

We had a bottle of the lake bay pinot gris and an order of the squid to start. For dinner we shared the cod and the beef short ribs. We split the deep fried cheesecake for dessert. 

More than anything, the service was phenomenal. We had some chats with the chefs as they were preparing food in front of us. The servers were very attentive and gave some great recommendations. We felt very well taken care of. 

If you have a chance, I recommend checking it out. I look forward to coming back and I think it will make a great addition to the ice district.

I was pretty disappointed after reading all the great reviews and seeing online that the prix fixe menu was going to be $80. We went here on New Year's Day and when we arrived, the menu was listed as $110 or $120 (for the hanger steak), i.e., different from what was advertised online. For a bill that amounted ultimately to over $400 for 2 people, I would have expected perfection. Instead, everything was too heavy (e.g., the brioche that comes with the foie gras was far too big; the gnocchi were drowning in cream; the creamsicle that came with the dessert could have been at most a third of the size it actually was since all it tasted of was cream and sugar; same goes for the large pile of chopped nuts that came on the dessert plate). Both the duck breast and the steak were far from the tenderness one would expect from a place like this, and we didn't finish either. The foie gras was just fine. The dessert looked like a Jackson Pollock painting, and not in a good way. All of it was just messy and stuffy. On the upside, the good flavors of the meal included the crab gnocchi, the brussel sprouts side that came with the duck, and the sorbet that was part of the dessert. The wines were also good. Was it worth the price? Absolutely not. This is just another tourist trap.

I drove to Nolensville Pike, attempting to find authentic mexican food. It happened to be both Taco Tuesday AND Cinco de Mayo. I ordered takeout, and the staff was so friendly. I got a beef soup that was delicious, along with a couple of steak street tacos. The soup was especially flavorful and filling. My friend got the chimichanga and thought it was delicious. I'm thankful for this restaurant and the wonderful people who make it great.
I have the AMC A-List and this is my second favorite AMC location near me. They have comfortable seats and tickets at a reasonable price

First time checking out this place- to go only because of the pandemic.  

Yummy yummy. Had the shrimp and filet- cooked perfect and tender . Love tater tots 

Hubby had the chicken pasta Asiago -- very flavorful 

On line ordering was simple and easy to customize. 

Pick up promptly and safely - masks and gloves and no contact except for the smile on our server's face. 

Will be back soon

Add this restaurant to your ' to go' places - you will be happy you did

A wonderfully attendant server and manager and a  clean environment did not make up for the mediocre experience this particular Sunday night. My wife, mother, and I were there for dinner with the ladies ordering steaks and I ordered salmon. My mother's prime rib was rare although requested to be medium and full of sinews and fat. We sent it back and a new piece came back more appropriately cooked but still inferior quality meat. My wife's sirloin was overcooked and then undercooked when a second piece was brought but acceptable after being brought out from the kitchen a third time. My salmon was only warm but was 95% evenly cooked. The ladies both had brownies for dessert but they were mushy from what I was told. The lady at the table next to us exclaimed out loud it was the worst piece of meat she had ever had and a person in the booth behind us had to send their meat back to be re-cooked also. The server warned us when we arrived that they were out of the normal bread that is so good and had no more New York strip steak though it was 5:00 p.m. in the afternoon. The combination of poor quality control and poor grades of beef made this a less than satisfactory experience.
Best Indian food I have had in Philly. Ordered chicken tikka masala and veggie samosas.

Seoul Fresh can easily fool anyone into thinking it's just another mall restaurant. Looks may deceive you but this is one of the best places I've gotten food in the pay 5 years of me working downtown. I got the Bruce Lee bowl, pic attached, and it was an incredible conglomerate of flavors goin off inside my mouth. This was the first time I've tried something like this and I was not disappointed. If you're ever in the circle center mall and need a bite to eat, this is where you go.

Just had the worst sandwich.  Avoid the salmon burger, it was terrible.  I thought it would be a salmon steak but it was processed like hamburger and tasted really off.  I couldn't eat it.  Fries and coleslaw were ok, but the burger was truly dreadful.  Hubby didn't care for his OMG BLT either.  He said he expected it to come back up.  When waitress asked if we wanted to box the leftovers, we said no, and told her it was so bad we were going for pizza.  She said she would bring her manager, but she didn't.   Instead she just brought the check.  We won't be going back.

Have wanted to try every since they opened! The Italian beef was very bland and ceaser salad very small for $5.99 and no croutons or egg ... the General manager was working the drive thru and told me receipt would be in bag  to do a review and receive a French fry next time in .. no receipt but not sure I want to try again... maybe a hotdog

Double Decker has been a staple growing up in Delco. I feel like it has gone a little downhill over the years but the insideouts are usually good. There have been times when they are empty but the restaurant is more than willing to give your money back or make a new order.

The food is what you would expect from just a side of the road diner. Which isn't surprising because that's what they are but with a little lipstick on outside. 

But the service is awful!!!!!  Truly the worst I have experienced while being in southern Idaho. I Never even saw my server until she dropped off the check. I had to ask random ones for help.
Restaurant was okay. Service was slow, food took a while to come out but it was good once we finally got it.

Absolute perfection. We went for my husbands birthday. I'd consider it an adult restaurant, wonderful wine selections and we got there in time for happy hour. We basically approached it like tapas, since everyone wanted to try everything on the menu- and everyone was happy with each plate. Great service, setting and food.
If you're in the mood for some great quality food, this is your place to go! We had spaghetti with marinara sauce, cheese pizza and garlic knots. Everything was freshly made and delicious!
Food is amazing, service is great, restaurant is very clean and welcoming. Highly recommend anything that has pork in it and the rice is great.

Right off this place packs that Duck Donuts goodness I've come to expect from them. The iced coffee and donuts were on point and delish! I would def give them a 5 but they were a bit understaffed today which resulted in a long wait for 2 donuts.

I got the sashimi plate & it did not taste fresh. If you order online you cannot see or select what types of sashimi you're getting I figured I just didn't like that particular one so I choked down a second piece & realized that it every single piece was old, discolored & had that fishy smell that's not supposed to be there. Threw it all away immediately. 

I also really don't care for how they plate it I don't want to pick a bunch of shredded carrots, chopped up lettuce and onions off my sushi. But I guess I'll never have to worry about that again.

My husband and I frequent Drunken Fish and have never been disappointed. We both LOVE the Edamame hummus. One of the best appetizers I've had here. The rolls are good (I particularly love the rainbow roll). Therese, our waitress tonight, has been outstanding. In fact our service here has always been strong. Love it!!

Came here back in February. We stumbled in here because of the live music. Came to find out Landon Parker was playing while we were there. He was great. Took request and had a beautiful voice. I don't remember what I had to drink, but we had a good time dancing.
Meh, server wasn't overly friendly and didn't bother to mention their kids menus until we were ready to order. Food was just okay.

We went on a Sunday night and it was pretty full for a Sunday night bar and grill type. Very nice place. The food was great. We got the shark bites and Helens Irish nachos for and appetizers. There was enough food it could have been a main dish. The helens Irish nachos was a lot like potato skins pretty good. The shark bites are fishy but were amazing in a Cajun garlic buttery liquid it was phenomenal. Then we shared the Syberg's chicken pizza with there ranch and Syberg's sauce it was great. The Cesar salad was huge would definitely feed at least 3. Overall great place definitely would stop in again. Wait staff was helpful as well.

My favorite pizza in Philly! They are square pies and the sauce goes on top of the cheese. I LOVE it!!!! I've gotten plain cheese, veggie supreme, meat lovers, and onions and they are al so so good. I've only ever gotten take out or delivery, but I do know the restaurant is BYOB if you want to sit there. Also they deliver for only $1.

Went again and the meat was real stringy, tasted like horsemeat. Yeah, I've had horsemeat. I mean when you live on a farm and Trigger dies. You can't throw out good meat. Look, I'm not proud of it. That said, I do not expect the same when paying top dollar, MR HOLLYWOOD!
My favorite neighborhood restaurant. Everyone is friendly, the food and drinks are on point and I have noticed that everything is always really clean. A+!
Updating my review to say our favorite sushi chef has left but Goz is just as amazing. The best sushi on St Pete beach. Highly recommend the "ninja" roll...the best.
OMG! They have deep fried Tacos. In my book that is all they need to do to get a 4 star rating. Beer helps too. Prices, Service, Cleanliness, all irrelevant if they have Deep Fried Tacos.
I walked in, and walked right out. The place is dirty, and the counter person was scratching her hair. No thanks.

I'm currently about 12 weeks pregnant... it's not super noticeable especially with a jacket on, but anyway, came here to watch some play off football with friends. I ordered a soda water w/ a little cranberry. The waitress probably couldn't hear us too well because the table next to us was chanting so loud. My drink came, it tasted weird, thought maybe the cranberry was bitter or their soda water just tasted. Only drank a little less than half of a very small glass and then realized it tasted way off. We got our check of course it said the drink had vodka in it. I asked the waitress if the drink really did have vodka and she said "yeah of course..." and then explained that I didn't order that because I couldn't drink at the time being. She said "oh sorry" then took my card. When she returned with it, she said "the manager doesn't let me take the drink off if it's been drank at all, I'm sorry about that." How would I have known it had vodka in it if I hadn't tasted it? I drank less than half of the drink. Why would they make me pay for a drink I didn't order especially if it was a health risk and tell me too bad? This is a lawsuit waiting to happen and the way management handled it is despicable. Do not give people like this your business, they are irresponsible and just plain careless.

We stopped in spontaneously on a Saturday night. Service was very friendly and efficient. My scallops were delicious. Soft and buttery..cooked to perfection. The accompanying jalapeno creamed corn was also very good. My companion had the Scottish salmon which he said was very good. I hope to return again soon.

Hibachi steak bento lunch box is a steal of a deal. Delicious and filling, well paired with the vegetable gyoza appetizer and a bottle of champagne to finish a nice afternoon date with the hubby.

Don't get me wrong, the place is decorated nicely, but nothing too special, but we were pleasantly surprised with the quality and the service...on point.

You know the experience: you find a well-reviewed place on Yelp, you make the trek, you see a well-designed menu, you get excited, you see cute decor and a decent tap list, you get more excited, you order, you pay, you wait, the food arrives, and it's...barely mediocre. That's Red Mesa Mercado to a 't.' 

We showed up on a weeknight between Christmas and New Year's having read about the Red Mesa family of restaurants in the local press. The menu is enticing: they've got legit options and a streamlined ordering system. 

My wife and I ordered the chips and guac + queso + salsa to start--along with a beer each. I'd bet a lot of money that the salsa isn't homemade. It looked and tasted too much like standard restaurant salsa. The chips were 100% not homemade either. How do I know? Next to Red Mesa's entrance is a supply room with windows--we saw several piles of pre-made and pre-packaged tortilla chips through the window on our way in. The guac was fine--nothing remarkable. The queso was decent. 

For mains, my wife had the fish tacos, which were the standout--surprisingly flavorful, though fried. I had a shrimp fajita bowl, which was seriously underwhelming. The shrimp was great, but the refried beans were probably from a can and the rice was overcooked. 

Final quibble: so. much. single. use plastic. Utensils, packaging, plates, bowls, beer glasses. Come on, guys. Invest in some decent metal flatware and reusable glasses. Or recycle.

Just WOW! We like to do foodie road trips (small plates from numerous restaurants) and included this on our recent tour. We ordered the chicken sate and cheese rolls. 
The chicken was AMAZING! Grilled kabob style with a coating that reminded me of massaman curry. A peanut dipping sauce and side salad with an fantastic honey dressing was also included. The meat was so tender and the sauces just wow! The cheese rolls were a soft cheese, unlike say a mozzarella stick, with such an amazing flavor and texture. They're deep fried and were super hot (temp), so be careful. They, too, came with a dipping sauce. Just an incredible experience. We will return for the full menu at a later time. Friendly service

Dined indoor a week ago and this place was amazing, adding it to one of our favorites spots in philly. The seatings were socially distanced with glass walls in between. Top notch service, amazing ambiance and delicious food! We got the biscuits and fennel honey butter to start out with, and then got the short rib over polenta and seafood risotto for entree - both were super delicious, especially the short ribs. Finished off with the caramel molten lava cake with peanut butter ice cream. We initially asked for the bread pudding but they ran out and let's us have the molten lava cake on the house! Highly recommend this place for a special occasion
Goodys is my favorite place for pizza, great quality and great people! If your looking for a local pizza place, I would definitely recommend goodys.

Calling all meat, and cheese LOVERS!!!!My husband, wanted to give this restuarant a try. If you are into extremely large portions and love meaty, cheesy food.This is the place for you. Again, they do NOT skimp on the cheese or meat. Enjoy!!!!!

Went for dinner and started with the crawfish beignets. Delicious! If they served those with greens, I would make it a meal. I then had the crawfish cakes with poached eggs and asparagus. Perfect light meal. My husband had the reddish and are every morsel. Service was pleasant and efficient. We will return!

THE BEST! Couldn't of picked a better place to spend my birthday with the greatest people and even better service. Hidden gem in South Tampa. Thank you so much for making my birthday so memorable my friends and I truly had the best time.
What a joke. No service for 20 minutes. Then they brought water. Then 20 more minutes and no offer to take our order. Music too loud, couldn't hear myself think. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

We arrived Tampa Airport & within 30 minutes we were ordering at Bracato's World Famous Szndwich shop.  Everyone focuses rightfully on  the food and we will review the service.   We noticed many people coming and going for primarily take out and some eating there like us.  The flow was smooth and controlled since they call out your number.   Upon pick up, one of their alert employees alerted us to select from their variety desert table based on a small Cuban sandwich we purchased. We ate outside on one of their picnic benches.  We noticed they had an employee cleaning windows and handles inside and another outside cleaning the floor around all tables.  We also noticed security cameras providing comfort while eating.  BEST OF ALL the owner visited us several times to insure we were pleased and if there was anything we needed.   He showed genuine interest in us and our background.  His listening skills would match that of a professional psychologist.  We left with smiles and will return since you get more than just World Class Food!!

Ate here because we had a Uber eats promo, normally stay away from this area. The poke bowl was small, for $16 large and the other bowl looks close to my size bowl. We probably would not come back, but it's decent and did not make us sick. The spicy crab was great, but the portions were super shitty for almost $47 delivered. We only got two bowls...
By far the best Chinese food I've ever had! I get pepper steak from here and I've never had a pepper steak that was so full of flavor. I'm so glad I found this place!

this used to be a good place but no longer. the price is too high and service is slow. I had breaded tenderloin, the breading fell off leaving a tough over cooked pork steak, my son had tacos that were tiny with hardly any filling. They have jacked up prices and lowered quality. There are many much better bar b  around. I would give a 0 if possible.

Little baby's ice cream is probably my new favorite ice cream place in Philly. The flavors are really interesting and the employees couldn't be nicer. I tried the butternut squash with brown sage butter flavor, and it was hands-down some of the best ice cream I've ever had. The only downside is that it is a bit more expensive than your typical scoop of ice cream, but you absolutely get what you pay for.

A wonderful upgrade to our Cleveland Street restaurant scene.  Now we have an actual Sports bar and restaurant we can walk to, hang out, eat great food, and imbibe to our hearts desires.

Owners are local, super friendly and truly care what is happening in and around our community.   

When you want to relax with your family or friends, chill out or watch a game - you can't miss here.

A local sushi restaurant with pretty typical menu items. Prices are very reasonable. The biggest reason to come here is for the personality and the thick slices of fish. I highly recommend this place for actual sushi lovers. If you care about what the decor looks like than the sushi, keep moving on.

Been coming to Getaway for a long time. Post Covid after they re-opened soooo different. No servers or bartenders. You order food via app on phone. You pay and tip before you even get your order. We  ordered a beer and they were out it, they could not replaced it, we had to go back to app and you have to reorder but you already tipped on that full amount from before. If you want another round you re-order on app and pay and tip again.

We have always taken amazing care of our server and bartender! And we still want to. But that doesn't exist anyone. 4 people stopped by table to drop stuff off yet we could never order via  one of them.

No one to clear table or give you napkins. 
We won't be back till servers and service comes back!!

The food is amazing here! It's the most authentic restaurant in central Indiana for sure. I came here and ordered cold soba and two rolls of sushi. The sushi rice was soft, and the seafood was fresh. The cold soba was very authentic with the dipping sauce, wasabi, seaweed and green onion toppings, and the fact that it was set over bamboo. We also ordered a red bean filled mochi which was delicious. It was wrapped in bamboo leaves, like a Chinese dessert. The only reason why I cannot rate it 4 stars is because when you dine in, it is fairly inconvenient. Google maps may confuse the restaurant with a shopping mart a couple blocks away. Then the parking lot has very limited space because of how crowded this restaurant always is. Even on a weekday, the restaurant is very busy during peak times! If you don't have a reservation, you may wait a very long time before seated. Then after you order, your wait time will be over 30 minutes because there's only a few sushi chefs. The restaurant is also small and hasn't been renovated in a while, so it doesn't have the best atmosphere. Our server, however, was one of the nicest servers I've ever had. So overall, although the atmosphere is a bit unsettling, the food honestly makes it worth it.

I've tried this place before for their bento box and been impressed so I thought I would try their lunch menu. I ordered the roll and kitchen lunch combo-sesame chicken, white rice, salad, and a mango shrimp roll. Decent amount of food for $10. The service was quick. However, I wasn't impressed with the chicken at all. Pretty bummed actually. There was barely any sauce and the chicken didn't even taste like chicken..it was stringy and hard. I ate the salad and rice which was good (can't really make that wrong though) and the sushi was good for a basic roll. I just probably won't come back here for typical Chinese take out items based on my experience with the kitchen. Food was ready quick and it was all hot, just much better chicken in the area.
Great cuppa Joe. I love their vanilla latte with their almond very substitute. It is amazing. Also have their caramel latte, but I do have to say vanilla is my favorite.

This is my all time favorite goto for sushi! It's been around for a long time! You see autographs on the walls framed by celebrities who come in!

It is small and quaint. Great date place once they open up for full dine in Business. Covid-19 has been very difficult on restaurants. 

I'm getting carryout and I try to support as many local restaurants as I can as I know that restaurants lose 80% of their revenue weekly. This is a depressing time for all of us right now...

We ordered 2 tenders plates with pimento mac & cheese, coleslaw, and french fries, Southern greens and red skin potato salad. There was a massive error on their online ordering system which caused an over hour wait for the food to even be prepared. Then, we sat in the "curbside pickup" parking spot for another 30 minutes, asking two staff members for assistance before they finally recognized the error... so they gave us a free banana pudding for dessert for our wait. 

The chicken was good!! It completely held up to the expectation of it being the best. The sides were just okay, but the main reason you're there is for the chicken. Focus on that! 

I would eat there again- in person, not ordering online.
Small place. Doesn't look like much from the outside. Inside is dated but very clean. And the food is out of this world.

Morning Glory is a tiny new diner located near the corner of Jefferson and Cherokee Street. 

How does it compare to other diners? It's small, the menu  and ingredients are basic, it has a jukebox, and it's cheap (everything under $10).  

What makes it different from other diners? It's nicely decorated, they take credit, the jukebox plays jazzy tunes, and they make their own sausage in-house, which I love. Parking is a little tricky with limited, metered street parking.  Friendly staff.  I'll be back

I must have driven past this place 100 times and finally decided to stop in for lunch on Saturday.  We got the food to go and the service at the counter is great as well as the food came out quickly.  The menu is up on a big board so you can read it as soon as you walk in.  Prices are very reasonable for what you get.  I had the greek salad w/ chicken and an order of pita and hummus.  All of my food tasted very fresh and the portions were generous.  The salad really was amazing and it also came with a few pieces of pita.  I will definitely go back, as it's quality food and you can get a healthy meal quickly.

I placed an order on Saturday for Father's Day Sunday. I had to pay at the time of the order which was no problem. The gentleman that answered the phone was very friendly and knowledgeable. He answered the questions that I had about the crabs they had and what to order. I ordered 3 pounds of Dungeness crabs and I was so pleased with my order. I placed the order for a pickup for 3pm and it was ready when I arrived. The woman at the counter was thankful for the order. The inside was very clean and well maintained. The order was exactly what I ordered and the crabs were amazing! I got the Pirate Sauce with a Medium heat and I would recommend this sauce. I am excited to return there when they can resume inside dining. The customer service was top notch and the food was beyond what I expected! I definitely recommend this place and it is better than any place in the area. My new crab spot!!

The food was amazing! Probably the tastiest duck fried rice I've had in the city. The staff was very friendly and the manager even offered us some free samples. Environment was relaxing and clean. I would love to visit again!
Very decent food, something for pretty much every possible allergy, I just wish that they had more GF baking, and that the service wasn't so variable.

We've eaten here several times and have only had very good food and good service. The menu has lots of tasty offerings for a variety of palates and culinary requirements. We have always left happy. 

From seafood to veg dishes, Mediterranean, seafood, and meatier fare. Large dog friendly shaded patio area olin back and lovely well decorated interior with tables and bar area. 

This is a first rate spot in Hyde Park Village. Very fair prices for high quality and accomodating service.
Really good sandwiches, fresh and tasty. But you were out of everything except Hague rolls, plan bread usage better!

A cozy Mediterranean joint that offers really authentic tasting dishes.  I have eaten likely 90% of the offerings, and have always been impressed.  It's byo too.

The various shawarma platters are all good and come with two sides for a list of about 6, I go with  Israeli salad and humus (pita comes with the entrees).  The cheese boreg is always crispy flakey on the outside and cheesy goodness on the inside.  The chicken is 17$ while filet is 19$.

The purveyor is a nice guy, always working the front during busy weekend dinners.  I will be moving from Philly soon, and will be sad to miss the Stone

If I could give this place 10 stars based solely on the food, I WOULD. This place had the besssstttttt southern food I had in my entire time at New Orleans for my birthday weekend. And it's the one place I would go back to if I ever came back to New Orleans.

Don't judge a book by its cover--even though the location and the building may not be the most inviting thing compared to the rest of the restaurants you'd see in the French Quarter, their food simply speaks for itself.

Food was worth the wait. Food was worth the drive. Mu husband and I came here right before a huge group of tourists and all we could hear from their table was how delicious the food was and we couldn't agree more.

Prior to visiting the south, I was not a fan of grits--but their shrimp and grits was soooooo goooood. I'd also recommend their fried chicken--the best Louisiana fried chicken I have ever had!!!!! I'm getting hungry again just thinking about the food and dessert we ordered and wish we could go back!

Whether you're from Louisiana or the south or visiting from some other place, don't leave NOLA without trying Heard Dat!!!

I asked for no bacon twice on my shrimp taco and guess what my take out tacos had all over them? Bacon. Not sure what the dried out brown stuff is on the side of the shell. I threw it away. 

However, the customer service was good.

This was our third visit to the Flamestone Grill, on our third visit to the area.  A solid, dependable steakhouse with a great menu, lots of choices and so far all our food has been very good.  This time we rolled in soaking wet from torrential summer rains.  The flame shrimp that we shared was excellent, just enough spice.  Seemed like a good night to take advantage of the french onion soup, which was excellent.  Warmed us up.  We each had a caesar salad with steak.  The meat was very tender and tasty.  I am always a bit leery of steak additions to salads, but this steak was very good.  
The service was friendly and efficient.  We will be back!

This was my first time here. I will be back with the mt crew. Cynthia was awesome she helped my wife and I to understand the menu & gave us time to pick are food.  Plus made sure that itvwas what we wanted.  My wife and I have been at a lot of restaurants and when you find a server who knows theie food it makes the food and environment awesome.  
I  had Gator Nuggets and Gumbo and Shrimp Po Boy. 

If you want to have a great night out this is the place. But if you get Cynthia you will have a  very great rime.
The Italian food here is among the best. We had seafood dishes which were very tasty. I had Creme Brûlée and coffee a great finish to an excellent meal.

I've been enjoying Carib Grill since they first opened, and I've never had a bad experience. The wait time can be husky, but it's worth it because the food is fresh and delicious! That jerk chicken, it's like your daddy grilled it in the back yard. And the oxtails taste like Grandmom cooked them in her kitchen. Everything so well done.
Not as great as I thought it would be. Our waitress was extremely unprofessional and did not know anything about the menu. The food was ok but nothing to write home about.

I have been eating tepanyaki for 40 years and I've never had as great of a service experience as we did here last night. Aldo was the most entertaining chef I've ever seen do this. His humor and showmanship made the meal extra special. We always have a great meal at Ijji2 but this time was over the top. 

Meal 5   
Show 10

I gave this place 5 stars when I last visited 2 years ago. Things have changed since then. Perhaps under new management:
* They changed the menu and took away very popular items
* 2 hours reservations make the servers rush you all the time to put in orders because it takes 20-30 mins to get a drink.
* Servers used to dress in prohibition age attire. No longer the case
* Dress code for patrons was also relaxed. People can now come in shorts and sandals
* A/C was either malfunctioning or they're trying to save on electricity because it was so hot at our table that it made us feel glad they have that 2 hour limit.

Definitely won't be going back nor recommending again.

I love this place! Their food is fantastic and unlike other Poke places (like Hai Street Kitchen), you get unlimited toppings. The quality of the fish is great and although it's on the more expensive side for a quick lunch, the portions are huge. My favorite thing about this place is that they offer cauliflower rice - it's an extra $1 but so worth it if you are attempting to eat healthy!

Interesting experience. We sat on the front patio and watched two sets of customers sit at a table next to us and leave because they never brought them menus. While our experience was ok, it was disappointing to see others so upset that they left. Our food was good after a long day in the sun. Drinks could have been a bit tastier.

We just had a great dinner.  A tremendous deal, too!  Delicious homemade soup, fresh salad, main course with perfectly prepared veggies and delicious potato cakes.  One of our best meals during our 5 day visit in SB.  Great service too.

This isa great restaurant right on Main Street. They offer great food in safe and friendly environment. The menu is varied and offers excellent options. I recommend this restaurant which is conveniently located just off the main thoroughfare between Philadelphia and exit 4 on the Turnpike.
If you are looking for a great dining experience come to Carollo's!!

What a gorgeous restaurant. Amazing food, attentive wait staff, a kitchen full of culinary magicians, and bartenders that know how to pour a proper cocktail. If you're in Indianapolis, make this place a priority.

The service is lousy should of went to hitters south. County instead of here I was her at 3:58pm Sunday and it empty and I was sitting 30 min before anyone took my order this is not good.customer service I will be contacting. Main hooters about this issue people came in after me got there order takin and I was still waiting for a wait to take
My order

I have been going to the diner for years when it was downtown. My friend and I had intended to go to a closer place but it was full so we decided to stop at the new location of the blue plate diner. I'm glad that we did. I was disappointed that they do not have cinnamon buns on weekdays but they do offer them on holidays and weekends. I ordered the blue plate special which is your standard breakfast bacon. The plate comes with a side of fruit compote which was a nice touch. My friend ordered blueberry pancakes and they were massive. They also came with a side of smashed potatoes. My friend had a young one with him and the servers were very accommodating. They provided a high chair and crayons for her to play. She's at the age where she likes to walk around a little bit and thankfully that didn't seem to be an issue. The decorations are nice it looks a little bit newer than the previous location. The service was good as well.

It's a fair not the best location down 69th street. The service is moderate. I haven't had any issues but notice some services catching attitudes towards their customers. Food is over priced and the water is tap. Wouldn't recommend eating from here
Easily the best burgers in the Tampa Bay area! Huge creative variety on their menu, as well. Everything from burgers, chicken & waffles, to empanadas.

This place is doing something right! Every time I go here it is very very busy. It's a fun environment/atmosphere, the staff was very friendly. It was a bit of a wait to get in there which is usually a good sign. It means people wanna eat there. The server was great, food was very good. Couple of small mistakes on the order but that's not a big deal, the place is packed!

True Food Kitchen  - King of Prussia.     We had the charred cauliflower which was scrumptious and the teriyaki tempeh with chicken... also mucho YUM-YUM.  For dessert (bad pic since it got attacked by us before I could snap a proper pic) flourless  chocolate cake with coconut ice-cream and cacao nibs - delicious but the cake was a bit on the dry side.    Service was extremely fast and attentive but not intrusive.  I really love all the  snake plants (probably 173 of them).  Outstanding patio seating - you are out side but protected from the elements.  Kid-friendly and I'm guessing pet-friendly..... very ADA accessible as well. I know it's strange to take pics of the  bathroom but I just loved the interior design of that.... so often that is overlooked.  Overall,  nourishing and healthy does not mean deprived.   Plenty of outstanding options whether you are vegan, gluten-free or a carnivore.  https://www.truefoodkitchen.com/truestory
Don't get the hype at all. Hot links were overpriced and dry. Brisket portions small and average. I guess its like they say, never meet your heros.

Very disappointed..went her last year when I was in town was awesome, recommended it to everyone headed this way. Went back last night and it was terrible.  The light and fluffy cornbread appetizer was burnt on the bottom and hard as a rock..the menu says expect a 15 minute wait for it's cooked fresh...um Nope it was out in less than 5..the entrees were okay...but my chicken sandwich bun was again hard and crusty. Then we asked for dessert selection and were told of this Atrawberry gooey cake...yes please!! Um...no thank you as it has NO strawberries..not in it...on top nothing.  And when we mentioned it to the waitress...she snotty response was "well they are cooked in it".  Our waitress came to our table 4times..to take our order...bring our food and dessert and then the check.  I am so saddened by this visit especially after telling people how great it was last year...will NOT go back and will tell people to steer
 Clear from now on

Im here in Philadelphia from Indianapolis with my wife getting treatment at Methodist Hospital. Was looking for a close place and was very happy with the order we received. It is was delivered very fast by our Doordash driver and arrived hot and ready to eat. Good job. Keep doing a great job.

Great pizza. Awesome flavor, great sauce and toppings.

The pizza was just as good reheated as it was the day I bought it. I even brought it home to my wife and four days later it still had amazing taste and texture. 

We will definitely be back!

Delicious sushi at a very affordable price point. Both the Monster Roll and the Mars Roll were very good! 

My only critique was service was a little bit slow on the busy Friday night I was there. Other than that, it was a tasty experience.

My family has been coming here for years to enjoy their great AYCE sushi and rolls.  Due to the pandemic, we did takeout tonight.  The order was ready when they said it would be; very quick 15 minutes!  We ordered a selection of sushi and rolls and found everything to be very fresh.  Our favorites tonight were the ika (extremely fresh and well prepared) and the Valentine roll.

Already looking forward to our next take out and someday dining again.
I love everything about A&W some of the best burgers and ice creams around. My favorite is there papa sauce which is home recipe of their thousand island sauce and chili cheese dogs are big and yummy

A cute little place to stop after a long day at the beach. Tons of outside seating is available & it sits right on the water so there's a nice view. There's live music every night, which I think is pretty neat. There's a large bar outside as well as inside. The inside was very nice; the entire restaurant was kept quite clean. We were seated right away. Our server, Daniel, was very personable & attentive. The menu is catered towards seafood, so as a vegetarian it was a little difficult for me to find something to eat. We were really craving chips & salsa, & though this wasn't on the menu our server was able to get some for us. I ordered vodka on the rocks, which tasted great but wasn't all to strong. My mom ordered Three Daughters Beach Blonde ale, & though they only served it by the can they brought her a cold glass so she could pretend it was on draft. For food I ordered a salad with bleu cheese, which was very delicious. My mom ordered some sort of mahi with veggies & beans & rice, & peanut butter pie for dessert. She was very pleased with her meal- especially the peanut butter pie! The only thing that was a bit disappointing was that our 10% yelp check in discount wasn't applied, even though we were told it would be. Would definitely go back- more for the atmosphere than anything else

They have such a yummy beef stew dish, fried rice dish and their soup and salads are a refreshing as appetizers!! The ambiance of the place is clean and trendy. All of the food is quality and full of flavor. They have boba teas and entrees such as hot pots, banh mi's, and curry as well! Highly recommend this Vietnamese restaurant. I appreciate the menu that is not overwhelmingly big, yet every dish is great. All the food here is quality!!!
Love this place a lunch time. The pork taco are my favorite. Cant beat the price and it's a few minutes from Sun City
Excellent, creative, unusual Mexican cuisine.  Highly recommended.

I went here late, not realizing they were closing and they told me they just got a huge, unexpected rush so they didn't have many choices left, but that they were happy to fire up the wok and make me whatever I wanted. I felt so bad for them to have to do that but they insisted and were so sweet and understanding and told me that was their job and they had no problem doing it. The girl at the window and the man on the speaker (who I think was the manager) were so friendly and she even brought it out to my car. The food was great, but the service was even better!

Open during the coronavirus lockdown for carry out, we were so pleased with our meal. Very generous portions of the grilled beef medallions and seafood pasta. Tiramisu was also delicious! Definitely recommend this restaurant.

I always drive by this place as I live down the street, and as I called around places tonight- all had huge waits. So we decided to try this place out since I alway say, "we should go there sometime." Man am I glad we did!!! The service was super quick, the portions were huge and the food was fresh. You could tell the chicken and shrimp were freshly breaded and both were very flavorful! We made it home in time when we would have just been getting into the other places!!!! Will definitely be going back!

Place was packed. Although waiters wore mask and gloves, all tables were being used. Took two hours to get our food. Had to ask several times for chips and cocktails. I asked for beef kabobs  rare, served well done. Not prepared for the amount of diners. Need to improve covid restrictions. We should have left but it kept on filling up.

My boyfriend and I got their menu in the mail and decided to try it out. I was surprised by how affordable the prices were and obviously that made us happy! we got the sweet and sour chicken and it was absolutely amazing, crunchy and hot!  The lo mein was great as well and the food was ready as soon as we got there exactly 10 minutes after placing the order! Definitely try it out were very impressed!

I have always driven by Mei's, and have always been intrigued by the idea of a General Tso's Chicken pizza. I never went in though or tried it though. Fast forward, 1 year later, I had a craving for Taiwanese food, and found out that Mei's World Pizza also specializes in Taiwanese food. Me and a friend came and tried out their scallion pancake, pork feet noodle soup, pepper-seasoned fried chicken. I thought the food wasn't the best. The scallion pancake was more crispy than flaky, and the pepper-seasoned fried chicken wasn't seasoned enough. The only thing that wasn't that bad was the pork feet noodle soup, but the soup was barely a soup. I felt as if it was the sauce that the pork feet cooks in, and they just threw some noodles into the bowl. That being said, I did see a lot of people come and go with pizza boxes, so maybe the pizza is better than the Taiwanese food. I might give the pizza a try someday, and I will most definitely update my review then. Other than the food, I loved the homey feel in the restaurant, and we were treated very nicely in the restaurant.

Morrow's is one of the best spots in New Orleans. This spot was recommended to me by a friend and it was the highlight of my trip.  It was in a residential neighborhood on the corner. As soon as I walked in I looked for the nearest seat at the bar.  Shortly after I was greeted by Blair P. who provided me a menu. To get started I ordered the all bets on me drink which was amazing. For appetizers I ordered stuffed mushrooms and my entrée of choice was the Cajun crawfish pasta. Everything was delicious and rich. The vibes and food was so great I decided to order another drink which Blair made with Hennessy since the first one included Hennessy.  I ordered peach cobbler to go. This is a must while in New Orleans.  Be sure to ask for Blair P.

We had such a great experience at Smiley's! The food is delicious, prices are right, and Smiley came to our table to welcome us and thank us for visiting. Would recommend this amazing little find in Manayunk to anyone! Get the Falafel Pita!
